bristle_count_note: 39 selected rods in 13 loose bundles; artistic simplification, not original count or exact full length

scientific_limits.en: SMF R4970 is crushed and not securely assigned to a species. Skull breadth, restored beak and cheek proportions, complete bristle tips, body thickness, color and pose are estimates. Tail bristles are directly evidenced, but their exact original count and full lengths are not reconstructed here. No species-specific pattern or sex is asserted.
scientific_limits.zh: SMF R4970受压扁且无法可靠归入具体种。头骨宽度、复原喙与颊部比例、完整鬃端、体厚、颜色及姿态均为估值。尾鬃有直接证据，但本模型不复刻其原始精确数量和完整长度。不主张特定种的花纹或性别。
